blocks.text: This chapter traces selected Benjaminite lines, including the line from Ner through Kish, Saul, Jonathan, and Merib-baal, and closes with Ulam's descendants described as mighty men and archers. The supplied synthesis cautions that the genealogies in this larger section function as selective literary maps of kinship, land, office, and restored identity rather than as exhaustive modern biological pedigrees. Gaps, parallel lines, variant names, and telescoping therefore require case-by-case review.
